subject: cd
question: Eliminate left recursion from: S→A, A→Ad|Ae|aB|aC, B→bBC|f, C→CF|Cd|g|h, E→g|ε, F→f|ε. Rule: A→Aα|β becomes A→βA', A'→αA'|ε.
title: Break The Endless Loop
hook: This grammar makes a parser loop forever.
answer: S→A, B→bBC|f, E→g|ε, F→f|ε are not left-recursive: unchanged.
A→Ad|Ae|aB|aC (α = d, e; β = aB, aC) becomes A→aBA'|aCA' and A'→dA'|eA'|ε.
C→CF|Cd|g|h (α = F, d; β = g, h) becomes C→gC'|hC' and C'→FC'|dC'|ε.
Final grammar: S→A, A→aBA'|aCA', A'→dA'|eA'|ε, B→bBC|f, C→gC'|hC', C'→FC'|dC'|ε, E→g|ε, F→f|ε.
